name: n8n-interaction-gateway
description: Generic signed-webhook interaction gateway for the n8n Workflow-as-Code portfolio: one authenticated POST edge that HMAC-verifies, size-limits, secret-strips, and routes a request by allowlisted intent to sibling workflow(s), with trace propagation. v0.4.0 ships the SDK workflow + pure security core proven OFFLINE (verify:gateway 20/20 + verify:workflow 16 golden scenarios incl. a differential vs the core), plus LIVE in-process Execute-Workflow sibling routing — single-target and multi-target fan-out — with all 6 portfolio workflows wired callable via executeWorkflowTrigger and proven end-to-end (verify:live).
